title: Configure the Carbonio edge proxy
description: Configure a Carbonio CE edge proxy joined to a ns8-carbonio main server

host.description: Host name (FQDN) of the proxy: web client and IMAP/POP3 server name. It cannot change after the first configuration.

lets_encrypt.description: Request a Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name, also used by IMAP and POP3

join.description: Module id of the ns8-carbonio main server to join. It cannot change after the first configuration.

admin_host.description: Optional host name (FQDN) that Traefik routes to the Carbonio Admin Panel through this proxy; empty: no route
